svg.title: One flat-lit input under three spatially varying environments
svg.desc: A shared flat-lit input conditions Generation. The earlier three panoramic environment maps retain their broad illumination, colored light regions, and spatial positions. The output body gradients combine contributions from across each full map: warm upper-left and cool lower-right, teal upper-right and warm lower-left, then blue overhead with a teal lower-left contribution. No cast shadows are drawn.
